instructions: Read every complete case in the paired workbook. The default is only a draft. Put a full Decision object in Override for every contradiction, then sign reviewedAllCases. The compiler refuses unsigned or candidate-less rows.

rows.Kwic: 譬如蒸砂作飯，豈療飢瘡？掘地覓天，莫覩霄漢。

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Chijue Daochong (痴絕道冲禪師語錄). Chijue Daochong is the exact speaker of the uninterrupted instruction: he compares intentional investigation and verbal theorizing to steaming sand to make rice and digging into earth to seek heaven.
